semantics.rust_signature: fn pick_operations_exact_native(weight_dtype: DType, compute_dtype: Option<DType>, load_device: Option<DeviceId>, disable_fast_fp8: bool, fp8_optimizations: bool, quant_config: Option<BTreeMap<String, LayerQuantizationV1>>, cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<NativeOperationSet, NativeOpsError>
semantics.mutation_rule: returns immutable validated policy without changing device capabilities, global state, or model parameters
semantics.alias_rule: the policy owns bounded metadata and constructed modules use immutable canonical parameter handles
semantics.shape_rule: selection is shape-neutral; each constructed NativeModule validates its own shapes
semantics.dtype_rule: matching or absent compute dtype selects direct storage, differing dtype selects manual cast, and quant metadata selects mixed precision
semantics.accumulation_dtype: the selected compute dtype is explicit and kernel owners define reduction precision
semantics.layout_rule: layout selection remains with convolution and quantization owners
semantics.device_rule: CPU ordinal zero is certified; other devices return typed unavailable without fallback
semantics.numeric_rule: CPU exposes no false fast-FP8 or cuBLAS capability and never selects an unavailable accelerated path
semantics.tolerance: selection is exact; selected kernels retain their declared tolerance
semantics.determinism: canonical dtype, device, and ordered quantization metadata uniquely determine the result
semantics.cancellation_points: before capability and metadata validation and before returning the policy
semantics.vjp_rule: selection is non-differentiable; selected kernels own gradients
semantics.jvp_rule: selection is non-differentiable; selected kernels own tangents
